method: cluster-grouped StratifiedGroupKFold (tools/build_dataset_v2.py); outer fold -> sealed test, remaining dev rows -> 5 folds; this split: train = dev folds 1-4, val = dev fold 0, test = sealed
group_key: cluster (exact SHA-256 duplicates collapsed; near-duplicates linked by pHash<=10 & CLIP-B/32 cos>=0.85, or cos>=0.92)
ood_suspect_definition: CLIP zero-shot flag: softmax mass on distractor concepts >= 0.25 (data/v2/leakage_report.json, ood_rule); flagged rows are kept
